description.zh:
实例ID。
> 当本参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，还需要传入**NodeId**参数。
description.en:
The instance ID.

> If you set this parameter to the ID of a sharded cluster instance, you must also specify the **NodeId** parameter.

description.zh: 数据库名，默认为所有数据库。
description.en: The name of the database. By default, all databases are queried.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > 查询结束时间距查询开始时间不得超过24个小时，超过则调用失败。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> The time range between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 24 hours. Otherwise, the operation fails.

description.zh:
审计记录返回的展示类型，取值：
- **File**：触发审计日志文件的生成，若传入这个值，只返回公共参数。
- **Stream**（默认值）：返回数据流。

>  **File** 参数已废弃
description.en:
The format of the returned audit records. Valid values:

- **File**: Triggers the generation of an audit log file. If you set this parameter to File, only common parameters are returned.

- **Stream** (default): Returns a data stream.

> The **File** parameter is deprecated.

description.zh: 关键字搜索的逻辑操作， 默认值为and。
description.en: The logical operator for the keyword search. The default value is and.

description.zh:
分片集群实例中Mongos节点ID或Shard节点ID。

> 当**DBInstanceId**参数传入的是分片集群实例ID时，本参数才可用。
description.en:
The ID of a Mongos node or a shard node in the sharded cluster instance.

> This parameter is available only when **DBInstanceId** is set to the ID of a sharded cluster instance.

description.zh:
按时间的升降序对查询到的慢日志进行排序。取值：
- **asc**：按时间升序排序。
- **desc**：按时间降序排序。
description.en:
The order in which to sort the returned audit log entries by time. Valid values:

- **asc**: Sorts the entries in ascending order.

- **desc**: Sorts the entries in descending order.

description.zh: 页码。大于0，且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number to return. The value must be greater than 0 and must not exceed the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: **1**.
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30** (default), **50**, and **100**.

description.zh: 关键字查询。多个关键字以空格分隔，不超过10个关键字。
description.en: The keywords for the query. You can specify up to 10 keywords. Separate multiple keywords with spaces.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 数据库账号，默认为所有账号。
description.en: The database account. By default, all accounts are queried.

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口时，实例的审计日志须处于开通状态，否则返回的审计日志内容为空。
- 本接口适用于规格类型为**通用型本地盘版**和**独享型本地盘版**实例。
- 本接口限制每分钟调用30次，如超过这个限制会被限流，请勿高频调用。如需高频调用，请使用Logstore，详情请参见[管理Logstore](~~48990~~)。
descriptions.en:
- When you call this operation, ensure that the audit log feature of the instance is enabled. Otherwise, the operation returns an empty audit log.

- This operation is applicable only to **general-purpose local-disk** and **dedicated local-disk** instances.

- You can call this operation up to 30 times per minute. To call this operation at a higher frequency, use a Logstore. For more information, see [Manage a Logstore](~~48990~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-audit-records --db-instance-id dds-bp12c5b040dc0000 --node-id d-bp128a0034360000 --start-time 2019-03-13T12:11:14Z --end-time 2019-03-13T13:11:14Z --database database0000 --user test --form Stream --query-keywords slow --logical-operator and --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --order-type asc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds DescribeAuditRecords --region cn-hangzhou --User test --OrderType asc --EndTime '2019-03-13T13:11:14Z' --QueryKeywords slow --PageSize 30 --DBInstanceId 'dds-bp12c5b040dc0000' --Form Stream --PageNumber 1 --LogicalOperator and --NodeId 'd-bp128a0034360000' --StartTime '2019-03-13T12:11:14Z' --Database database0000
